name: omaotp
author: qempexe
description: TOTP authenticator for the Omarchy bar: one-time codes with countdown rings, stored in an encrypted local vault. Themed panel with a live-reloaded settings file.

schema.label: Accent color
schema.description: theme takes the background, text and accent of the Omarchy theme, custom uses customColor as the accent, mono uses shades of the bar text color.

schema.label: Custom color
schema.description: Hex color (#rrggbb), used when colorMode is custom.

schema.label: Lock after
schema.description: Minutes after the panel closes before the vault locks. One of 1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30.

schema.label: Clear clipboard after
schema.description: Seconds before a copied code is cleared from the clipboard. One of 10, 20, 30, 60, 120.
